protocol: BATCH15 last unresolved 17, first 15 unique question units/30 grade IDs
review_team: One assistant applying Avengers technical/source/scope/linguistic/QA checklists; no genuine independent agents
warnings: Evidence cards PRELIMINARY, deliberately not resolving source scope where absent. No operational high-voltage instructions. Original QABC and keys immutable. No merge/release.

cards.question_original: La conectarea unui circuit de linie se recomandă următoarea  ordine a manevrelor:
cards.A_original: separatorul de linie, separatorul de bare, întreruptorul;
cards.B_original: separatorul de bare, întreruptorul, separatorul de linie;
cards.C_original: separatorul de bare, separatorul de linie, întreruptorul .

source_evidence.locator: Schneider EIG isolation/interlocks, scope does NOT prescribe specific bus/line switching sequence

cards.context_positive: Intended multiple-choice C places a normal load-breaking breaker after non-load-breaking disconnectors. Technical requirement: separators must not be asked to interrupt load current. This is question-analysis only, never switching instructions.

ABC_analysis.A: A: alternative switching order not disproved for every arrangement without exact system diagram/interlocks.
ABC_analysis.B: B: closes breaker before last disconnector, which may place current burden across a disconnector and is unsafe for ordinary isolator assumptions.
ABC_analysis.C: C: imported test order presupposes the station's disconnector/breaker type, absence of load, interlocking and an authorized local procedure.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Some switchgear types are load-break disconnectors and supply arrangements differ; generic source on interlocks cannot certify exact local line/bus order or switching safety.

cards.question_original: La deconectarea unui circuit de linie se recomandă următoarea  ordine a manevrelor:
cards.A_original: separatorul de linie, întreruptorul, separatorul de bare;
cards.B_original: separatorul de bare, întreruptorul, separatorul de linie;
cards.C_original: întreruptorul, separatorul de  linie, separatorul de bare.

source_evidence.locator: Schneider isolation interlock principles, not exact operation order

cards.context_positive: The intended C puts a dedicated breaker before any ordinary off-load disconnector in the test logic, consistent with isolator not being a load-current-breaking device. The requested full order is NOT established by this generic rule.

ABC_analysis.A: A: places disconnector before breaker, incompatible with normal isolator load-breaking restrictions.
ABC_analysis.B: B: places bus isolator before breaker, incompatible with normal off-load isolator assumptions.
ABC_analysis.C: C: intended exam sequence; remaining two isolator steps require exact station schematic, interlocks and local switching procedure.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: A different bay layout or energized adjacent bus may require different approved isolation sequence; no instruction for physical HV operations is authorized by a quiz key.

cards.question_original: Secţionarea barelor colectoare în staţiile electrice are scopul:
cards.A_original: de limitare a curenţilor de scurtcircuit
cards.C_original: de a reduce pierderile de putere

source_evidence.locator: Schneider topology discussion, conceptual evidence only

cards.context_positive: Sectionalizing busbars can reduce bus fault current when source contributions are separated and the coupling breaker remains open. It can also improve availability by isolating faults; context determines dominant objective.

ABC_analysis.A: A: potential legitimate purpose in two-source sectionalized configuration; not guaranteed for one transformer.
ABC_analysis.B: B: additional cubicle/coupler usually raises rather than automatically lowers capex.
ABC_analysis.C: C: Joule losses are not the defining design target of bus sectioning.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: With one transformer feeding two bus sections via closed tie, splitting labels does not reduce available short-circuit current at a common location.

cards.question_original: Sistemul de tensiuni al unei reţele racordate la un generator electric care produce tensiuni electromotoare simetrice:
cards.B_original: este simetric chiar dacă fazele sunt neegal încărcate
cards.C_original: este simetric dacă fazele sunt egal încărcate

source_evidence.locator: Kirtley symmetrical-component decomposition, technical background not direct guarantee under equal load

cards.context_positive: Symmetrical three-phase source EMFs and equal phase loadings lead to symmetrical bus voltages only when phase impedances, topology and fault conditions are also symmetrical.

ABC_analysis.A: A: 'always symmetrical' false because network impedance and loads can be asymmetrical.
ABC_analysis.B: B: unequal loading can yield unequal voltage drops and asymmetrical received voltages.
ABC_analysis.C: C: exam intended under symmetric network assumption not explicit in stem.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Balanced three-phase generator feeds equal loads via three lines of different resistances: delivered terminal voltages unequal even though generator EMFs and load resistances are symmetric.

cards.question_original: Transformatoarele cu ulei prevăzute cu conservator prezintă următoarele caracteristici:
cards.A_original: dilatarea lichidului este compensată prin deformarea elastică a pereţilor cuvei;
cards.B_original: împiedică, dar nu elimină, pătrunderea umidităţii în interiorul rezervorului de expansiune;
cards.C_original: asigură facilităţi în modul de dispunere a bornelor şi deci de racordare la reţea.

source_evidence.locator: Hitachi dehydrating breather for moisture control with transformer conservators

cards.context_positive: Oil conservator is an expansion volume for transformer oil; when a silica-gel/dehydrating breather is fitted it reduces moisture intake but does not guarantee absolutely dry interior.

ABC_analysis.A: A: elastic tank-wall expansion is sealed-tank strategy distinct from conservator expansion.
ABC_analysis.B: B: plausible for conservator PLUS correctly serviced dehydrating breather, not existence of conservator alone.
ABC_analysis.C: C: terminal/bushing arrangement not central function of conservator.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Conservator ventilating directly to humid atmosphere without dehydrating breather may allow moisture ingress; B does not automatically follow from word 'conservator'.

cards.question_original: Un separator pe un circuit de înalta tensiune poate fi manevrat:
cards.C_original: fãrã curent, fãrã tensiune sau sub tensiune, fãrã curent

source_evidence.locator: General isolator/interlock principles; not site-specific MV/HV procedure

cards.context_positive: An ordinary high-voltage disconnector is an off-load isolating device; the given C is conceptually aimed at no-load operation and differs from a circuit breaker or load-break switch. No field instructions follow.

ABC_analysis.A: A: an ordinary disconnector cannot safely interrupt operating load current.
ABC_analysis.B: B: inconsistent phrase current without voltage does not provide standard rated load-switching duty.
ABC_analysis.C: C: intended normal off-load disconnector answer, but special charging/commutation abilities and interlocks may vary.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Load-break switch-disconnector is a distinct device rated for certain load switching; equipment category, local SOP and actual station safety must be checked.

cards.A_original: nu pot fi lăsate în exploatare cu înfăşurarea secundara deschisa
cards.B_original: nu pot fi lăsate în exploatare cu înfăşurarea secundara în scurtcircuit
cards.C_original: pot fi puse sub tensiune cu înfăşurarea secundara in scurtcircuit

source_evidence.locator: ABB installation manual §1.5.1 safety, VT secondary short circuit warning, indexed PDF text

cards.context_positive: A conventional voltage transformer secondary behaves as voltage source: it can run unloaded/open, but shorting it can produce dangerous excessive current/heat. This contrasts with the high-voltage hazard from opening an energized current-transformer secondary.

ABC_analysis.A: A: VT can work at no secondary load (open circuit).
ABC_analysis.B: B: correct general prohibition against leaving a VT secondary shorted under normal operation.
ABC_analysis.C: C: energization with VT secondary shorted is unsafe.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Manufacturer ABB CVC-110B combination instrument transformer manual 2026 explicitly warns 'Never short circuit ... voltage transformer' and overheating. PDF text indexed, not visually reviewed via screenshot.

cards.question_original: Utilizarea unei cuple longo-transversale se preferă atunci când dorim:
cards.B_original: o siguranţă în funcţionare mai mare;

source_evidence.locator: MV switchgear general article NOT exact combined coupler single-line

cards.context_positive: A longitudinal/transverse combined bus coupler may increase supply transfer flexibility and continuity in an appropriate bay layout. However the exact authentic single-line diagram and historical exam source is missing.

ABC_analysis.A: A: shortening maneuvers could be a possible implementation effect, not a proven primary preference.
ABC_analysis.B: B: plausible intended operational reliability benefit only with exact topology and protection layout.
ABC_analysis.C: C: a combined coupler can change capex either way, so claim of uniform saving unsupported.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Compare ELE-026 which imports C for multifunction coupler cost reduction; two similarly worded items may refer to distinct topologies or contradictory exam assumptions. Without two exact diagrams cannot adjudicate the pair.

cards.question_original: Un corp conductor situat într-un câmp electric de intensitate E se încarcă cu electricitate:

source_evidence.locator: OpenStax electrostatic induction/charging, separate induced redistribution from net charge

cards.context_positive: An initially neutral conductor placed in external electric field redistributes mobile free charges by electrostatic induction, yielding separated positive and negative surface regions.

ABC_analysis.A: A: conduction charging requires net charge transfer through physical connection, not merely exposure.
ABC_analysis.B: B: induced polarization/charge separation is intended; cannot claim conductor necessarily acquires NET electric charge.
ABC_analysis.C: C: magnetization pertains to magnetic response, not electrostatic charge redistribution.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Neutral isolated metal sphere in static field becomes polarized yet total net charge is zero. To gain lasting net charge by induction normally grounding or charge transfer step is needed.

cards.A_original: numai protecţia în caz de scurtcircuit;
cards.C_original: izolarea personalului care lucrează la întreruptor, de restul instalaţiei aflată sub tensiune.

source_evidence.locator: Fixed and withdrawable MV switchgear advantages, not site-specific safety certificate

cards.context_positive: A withdrawable breaker in a correctly built cell can be withdrawn to a separated position with shutters and interlocks protecting personnel from energized fixed parts.

ABC_analysis.A: A: 'only' short-circuit protection false, breaker is also operating switching component.
ABC_analysis.B: B: voltage surge protection typically relies on dedicated arresters and insulation coordination.
ABC_analysis.C: C: intended improved separation during breaker maintenance, but not sufficient without PPE, isolation verification and site rules.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Withdrawable mechanism with shutters damaged or incompletely isolated can still expose dangerous energized components; the mere word 'withdrawable' is not a guarantee of personal isolation.

cards.A_original: nu asigură eliminarea unor greşeli de manevră datorate separatoarelor;
cards.B_original: asigură scurtarea duratei reviziilor la celule;
cards.C_original: asigură numai izolarea personalului care lucrează la întreruptor, de restul instalaţiei aflată sub tensiune.

source_evidence.locator: Fixed versus withdrawable maintenance, engineering comparison

cards.context_positive: Withdrawable breakers allow replacing/servicing movable switching assembly independently of fixed cubicle, potentially shortening breaker-specific maintenance outages.

ABC_analysis.A: A: some withdrawal interlocks eliminate isolator sequencing errors, so blanket negative is unjustified.
ABC_analysis.B: B: valid in appropriate switchgear design and for breaker-specific servicing, not universal every cubicle overhaul.
ABC_analysis.C: C: 'only' misses maintainability and operational flexibility; personnel still need isolation checks.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Maintenance of fixed busbar/shutters may still require full station outage and may be no quicker than fixed-pattern equipment.

cards.A_original: între reţelele de                     110 kV şi 220 kV
cards.B_original: numai între reţelele de              220 kV şi 400 kV
cards.C_original: între reţelele de                   20 kV şi 110 kV

source_evidence.locator: Transelectrica official PD RET 2026-2035 mentions 220/110 Stupărei and 400/220 Arefu, PDF search text not screenshot QA

cards.context_positive: Autotransformer commonly interconnects transmission networks with relatively close HV levels, including actual 220/110 kV; the 400/220 kV pair is also used, so option B's 'only' is contradicted.

ABC_analysis.A: A: documented valid real-world 220/110 kV example and intended exam answer.
ABC_analysis.B: B: 'only' 220/400 kV false because 220/110 is also documented.
ABC_analysis.C: C: 20/110 kV high ratio is less typical for transmission autotransformer, but technical impossibility not proven.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Transelectrica power-system plan lists 220/110 and 400/220 examples; it is a report, not the sole valid voltage-ratio taxonomy. PDF has not received visual screenshot QA.

cards.question_original: Utilizarea unei cuple cu functiuni multiple se prefera atunci cand dorim

source_evidence.locator: Original ABB power distribution handbook cited in pre-review; exact diagram/capex equation not visually checked

cards.context_positive: Multifunction bus coupler may combine switching/section coupling functions and reduce duplicated switchgear investment, explaining intended C as a cost tradeoff, but schematic/cost comparison is not available.

ABC_analysis.A: A: maneuver time is topology and interlock dependent; cannot affirm as primary advantage without a switching study.
ABC_analysis.B: B: availability might improve but cannot be deduced solely from multifunction label.
ABC_analysis.C: C: fewer separate devices can lower capex in an applicable substation, NOT always.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: A multifunction coupler with extra interrupter/interlocking can cost more than separate simpler equipment in a particular station. Do NOT conflate this item with ELE-246 longitudinal-transverse coupler imported B.

cards.question_original: Curentul produs într-un circuit care conţine elemente neliniare şi care este alimentat cu o tensiune sinusoidală este:
cards.C_original: nesinusoidal sau sinusoidal, depinde de natura elementelor neliniare

source_evidence.locator: Schneider harmonic generation by nonlinear loads, only supports typical distortion
OpenStax ohmic vs non-ohmic material behavior

cards.context_positive: Nonlinear load voltage-current relation may introduce waveform harmonics with a sinusoidal voltage; shape depends on nonlinear device, operating point and circuit. An unused/unexcited nonlinear branch may coexist with a purely sinusoidal active branch.

ABC_analysis.A: A: 'always nonsinusoidal' fails if nonlinear element is not conducting/excited or effective composite response remains linear in tested range.
ABC_analysis.B: B: 'always sinusoidal' fails for ordinary diode rectifier or saturation cases producing harmonics.
ABC_analysis.C: C: plausible intended conditional category, not a formal guarantee of all possible nonlinear circuits without specifying operating conditions.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Take sinusoidal voltage across an ohmic resistor in one branch and a reverse-biased ideal blocking nonlinear diode in another branch, current is sinusoidal. Conversely, a nonlinear polynomial i=gv+av³ yields third harmonic when a≠0.

cards.question_original: Dacă o tensiune electromotoare E, montată în latura AB a unei reţele pasive, produce în latura CD a reţelei un curent I, montarea t.e.m. E în latura CD va produce în latura AB:

source_evidence.locator: Niknejad UC Berkeley 2000, Chapter2 §2.1.2 Reciprocity, printed p17, equation2.9 and passive gyrator counterexample
OpenStax mutual inductance symmetry special case, NOT general passive network reciprocity proof

cards.context_positive: The imported B requires a reciprocal transfer theorem: for linear bilateral reciprocal networks with consistent source/current reference directions, transfer admittances match when source and response branches are interchanged. However PASSIVE is insufficient to ensure reciprocity.

ABC_analysis.A: A: sign depends on reference choices and is not determined by the passive property alone.
ABC_analysis.B: B: valid under reciprocal bilateral linear network and matching reference conventions, but NOT derivable from passivity alone.
ABC_analysis.C: C: factor 1/2 not entailed generally; passive nonreciprocal networks can have unequal transfer coefficients.

cards.pairwise_and_counterexample: Berkeley electrical-engineering doctoral thesis (Niknejad 2000, p17, §2.1.2) explicitly describes a passive gyrator as nonreciprocal. Its transfer behavior breaks the 'equal currents' inference. PDF text found; web page screenshot failed (cache miss).
